_readme: Who made it and how to say thanks. Read at startup, so anything changed here shows up in the app's About page the next time it opens -- no rebuild needed. Leave a field empty and it is simply not shown; nothing here is ever invented for you.
author: Obly
tagline: Free to use, free to pass on.
_contact_note: Where a bug report should go. A Discord invite, an email, a Telegram handle -- whatever you actually want to read. Empty means the app shows no contact at all, which is better than pointing people somewhere nobody is listening.
_donate_note: Optional and genuinely optional -- the app says the program is free either way, and never nags. Both label and value must be filled in before anything appears; a donation prompt with a wrong handle sends money to a stranger, so a half-filled entry shows nothing.
thanks: This is free and always will be. If it saved you some hassle and you want to throw something in the hat, that's the hat.
